text: Castelli is a brand of the MVC Group (Manifattura Valcismon S.p.A.), an Italian sportswear group that describes itself as family owned since 1946.
short: Castelli is a brand of the family-owned MVC Group.

source.name: MVC Group: About Us
source.quote: We are an Italian house of brands, family owned since 1946 and specialized in sportswear.
source.note: The group's brand list on the same site (Our brands) is Sportful, Castelli, Karpos and Zoot; the Castelli brand page is mvcgroup.com/en/castelli. Page without a date; opened 2026-10-01.
